other_conditions: Self‑employment loan eligibility requires age between 18 and 60 years
Artificial limb and equipment eligibility requires age greater than 5 years
Special school scholarship eligibility requires student age between 6 and 18 years
Shelter home (Ashiyana/Saket) eligibility requires beneficiary to be at least 18 years old, male or female
In very special cases, grants are payable without any restriction on income or age for persons with multiple disabilities
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to Rs 2 lakh for self‑employment and scholarships for teaching in special schools, with additional grant assistance as needed.
